In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the photorespiration process is not a loss of carbon dioxide, but rather a loss of energy, which is a consequence of the oxygenase activity of the enzyme Rubisco, the main carbon dioxide fixation enzyme.
photorespiration is an unavoidable consequence of the C3 pathway of carbon assimilation.
photorespiration is not a wasteful process, but a process that has evolved to protect plants from photoinhibition and to protect Rubisco from photoinhibition.
